attchmntText: Usha Martin Education & Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Usha Martin Education and Solutions Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of un-audited financial results for the first quarter ended 30th September 2026. The results were published in Business Standard and Arthik Lipi on 14th November 2026. The filing was signed by Sumeet Kumar, Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Usha Martin Education & Solutions Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Usha Martin Education and Solutions Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board considered and approved the Un-audited Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. These results cover both Standalone and Consolidated figures. The company enclosed the detailed financial results in the format prescribed under Regulation 33 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. A Limited Review Report was also provided. A declaration regarding an unmodified opinion was included as per Listing Regulations. The meeting commenced at 01.00 P.M. and concluded at 03.10 P.M. Sumeet Kumar, the CS and Compliance Officer, signed the communication.
